# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a mustache which he curls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is a sarcastic and hypocritical teacher who carries out his duties with spasmodic fits of reform. He is prone to favoritism and is easily distracted from his duties by his romantic interests. When enforcing discipline, he tends to be vindictive and harsh toward helpless students while ignoring the wrongdoings of others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school. During his tenure, he focused much of his time and attention on his older students preparing for Queen's Academy, particularly Prissy Andrews, whom he courted. He maintained poor order in his classroom, periodically attempting strict enforcement through sarcastic punishments and scapegoating. After Anne Shirley arrived at the school, he humiliated her by misspelling her name, forcing her to stand before the blackboard for losing her temper, and later forcing her to sit with Gilbert Blythe for being late. He also took part in the Avonlea Debating Club's winter concert by reciting Mark Antony's oration. At the end of the school year in June, he delivered a farewell speech to the students before leaving his post at Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Boarded at Eben Wright's house while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Obtained his teaching position at Avonlea because his uncle was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
